metadata.title: Double Fibration Transforms: Geometry and Microlocal Analysis
metadata.abstract: Double fibration transforms integrate functions over families of submanifolds. We survey the recovery of singularities by both classical normal operator methods and direct analytic methods. We also discuss support theorems, injectivity and applications to geodesic ray transforms, seismic inversion and minimal surface data.
metadata.comment: Survey article. Accepted for publication in Extended Abstracts IPMS 2026 Conference - "Inverse Problems: Modeling and Simulation"

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 综述沿子流形族积分的双纤维化变换，比较经典正规算子方法和直接解析方法对奇性的恢复，并讨论支集定理、单射性及测地射线变换、地震反演和极小曲面数据的应用。
techniques: 正规算子与微局部分析
analysis.breakthrough: 为几何逆问题组织奇性恢复的互补技术及应用背景。
analysis.limitations: 本文是综述，摘要未宣称统一新单射定理；不同变换的几何假设不能相互替代。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。8页全文关键词及点写/断行模型名/Danus补检均无AI候选，核对第7页Acknowledgements仅列科研资助，未观察作者自用AI披露；不等于确认未用AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何分析与逆问题的实用方法概览，适合补充阅读。
